title: Oke Shannon discussed on classified servers
summary: Dylan Borland tells of Oke Shannon discussed on classified servers, about before 2024 at classified servers (JWICS), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: justifications. But, uh, Oak Shannon was a massive conversation on the classified servers

plain: A man named Dylan Borland, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, says that sometime before 2024 a subject he calls Oke Shannon was "a massive conversation" on JWICS, a top secret computer network the US government uses for intelligence. He says he saw this himself, and he tells it because, if true, it would mean the subject was being discussed seriously inside the intelligence world.
